faq.a: Necdet is associated with the Arabic form نَجْدَت, whose core sense is necdet; help, succour (turkish form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Necdet?
faq.a: Necdet is associated with Arabic. Necdet is the Turkish form of Arabic نَجْدَة (Najda), meaning 'help, succour'.
Yes — the underlying form نَجْدَت is Arabic.
Necdet can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Necdet should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Najda is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Necdet, necdet. Script forms are نجدت, نَجْدَت, नजदत.

faq.q: Is Necdet a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
